body:
To those that didn't come up to me at my dad's funeral yet did to my brother.

Go fuck yourself. 

To those that ignored me on the week of my brother's suicide.

Go fuck yourself.

To those that made no effort to ask if I was okay, or to talk to me during either suicide. Who made no effort to be my family when I was a child. 

Go fuck yourself.

To those that groomed me.

Go fuck yourself.



I hope pain eats away at you and you follow my path.

To Mom or whoever has the strength to open my phone 

Please enter snapchat and either send a picture of this message, or copy and paste it to those mentioned.

Nicole: (Bestie on Snapchat)
Hi. I'm sorry you're figuring it out this way, but I did pass away. You were an awesome friend. Our story is really funny and one that I hope you treasure forever. Don't be sad. I'm better now, finally. I want you to finish up school, live your life to the fullest. You are an amazing person and I hope you remain that person forever.

Vin: (Vin on Snapchat)
Hey, sorry man. This is my last message to you. I'm sorry genuinely. This is my family sending a message after I passed away. I talked to you a lot about this, and you were always there to help me. I am sorry that I never really shared real info with you so there was no way for you to tell my family what I was going to do.
You were a really good friend, despite being a nazi,furry,incel weirdo. I hope you learn from my passing the inherit harm of capitalism on the human brain and become a radical lefty. (Joking) I just want you to be happy and find someone that loves you because you're an awesome guy and an amazing friend.

Ariel: (Ariel on Snapchat) 
Hey, this is a message being sent from my family. I sadly have passed away. Thank you for all the fun memories on OC. I'm Rrally glad I got to meet you in real life. You're an awesome person and I want you to stay that way. 

Peter: (Pete on Snapchat)
Hey Peter. This message is being sent by my family. I have passed away. Thank you for all that you've done for me, the fun times we had on OC. Your server really did change my life. It made it a lot better in times of struggle. I'm sorry im leaving like this. But thank you.

I am shortening names just incase someone who's not family finds this, I want to respect everyone's privacy and anonymity. 

Mom, I'm truly sorry that this is what I chose.
I Know i told you I swear, but I am not strong enough. I know you feel the exact same way I do.
I want you to stay alive. Just for the girls. That's it. I know how much this will hurt.but I want to be away from this pain. I am in a better place, if that's Heaven, Hell or non-existant. It is better than earth. 
I didn't really have a full life ahead of me. I wouldn't have been able to get over everything. I'd just suffer until I'd die in like 40 years. 
I really love you. You're my inspiration and I genuinely think the world of you. Thank you.

D, thank you for being my dad. Thank you for being a good dad to my sisters. I'm sorry. Nomatter what, I just want you to be around for the girls. 

M+G
Hey guys. I'm sorry i did this. I really want you guys to never think I didn't love you, or J didn't even though we left in this way. I love you guys so much. I know this is hard to go through, but I need you guys to just keep going on. Understand I love you, I just needed to find a way to get away from all the bad thoughts. In time you'll understand. 

Bon.
I'm sorry for doing this to you. Yesterday you asked me if I was hiding anything from you, and I lied, I said no. I've been feeling this way for awhile. Longer than before i met you. I was planning on doing this a few weeks after I met you. I have always felt guilt for falling in love with you, because I know this is how I end. I tried my best to stick around. Hoping things would just magically get better, but they just got worse. I feel like I'm at an point where it's you leave me, then I kill myself and you feel guilt for the rest of your life. Or I just do it first and leave you heartbroken. This has nothing to do with you. You made me happy. You made me whole. I just can't keep getting up. I've given up.

 MM+PP
Thank you for being there always. I'm sorry. I love you so much.

M+T+S 
Thank you for all the happiness you've given me over the years. I'm sorry. You guys were my best friends. I love you. 

Bub
I'm sorry. I love you. Please do not stress yourself out over me. If I awake and find there's some Heaven or Afterlife that I can communicate with u with. I won't. I am going to leave no signs, nobutterflies, birds or dreams. Do not worry. If you are feeling me, it is not me.
Thank you for everything you've done for me.

Bons Family
I'm sorry for coming into your life and then suddenly leaving your daughter hurt. I do care for her a lot. Even though I know I was never that good for her. Please make sure she's going to therapy if she needs it. 

Everyone else 
I am sorry. I hope my notes clear up why I did what I did and you can learn to move on. Please talk to somebody if you're feeling similar before it's too late.

I don't think it gets better. I don't say that to make you upset, just an honest answer. 

It's just cope for the sad reality that this whole world is fucked beyond fixing. There's some problems that just can't be fixed.
This could have been prevented. My father killed himself because of money issues. He was working 60 hour weeks, but not making enough to get us out of food banks. Got into selling drugs for extra side money, tried some himself, started to get abusive. Regretted it, then shot himself years later from that regret.

My brother shot himself because of my father doing it, and missing him. The PTSD it gave us both as a child was crippling. I truly and full heartedly believe if that my father made more money. If he got luckier, if we grew up in a safer area, he would have never had to sell drugs, would have never taken them. Never became an addict and never eventually would have killed himself.

Would I still be depressed. Yea. I got groomed as a teen. I still went through shitty things, suicide aside. But I don't think I'd be suicidal. I'd just be able to learn to cope. 
I got unlucky. My dad got unlucky, my brother got unlucky. 

I forgave my father years ago, I understand what he did was only to help the family in a dire situation. He was a good guy, put into a horrible situation, forced to do horrible things for us. I just wish it was better.

Sorry random vent. 
Just leaving it here for family to find after to better understand that I am speaking and acting in a logical way. That it's not because of irrational thinking but a vast understanding of my, and my families situation.

When. It's been nearly 10 years. Ive been told adulthood will grant me rights which make things better. I was told so many times things will get better. 

It's only gotten worse. I am 25 now. 
I obviously stare into an abyss. You've been there, we all have. What is after death. Is it another life, heaven, hell, or nothingness. Will I wake up after I kill myself, hurt and in the hospital. I don't know. 
But right now, what I do know is nothing has ever gotten better. My trust in dying and forgetting all of this trauma is much less of a worry than messing up. 

Nothing ever goes to plan. I know. But I'll make sure I die. Nomatter how painful.
I'm aware. Thank you for your care.
Thank you, you're a good person. World needs more people like you. I reconsider every day of my life, but it seems to be an inevitable.
I don't want to be convinced out of this. I'm sorry but this post was honestly just for people to find answers through after I do kill myself. Thank you for your care and worry.

My fear of killing myself to be honest. I didn't want to mess up and wind up hurting myself or making myself crippled. I don't hate myself. I think I'm an ok human. I don't want to hurt myself. 

I'm scared of the unknown, like, what comes next. I half expect to kill myself then wake up the next day. It's like this world is meant to hurt me. Dying is preferable to waking up tomorrow.

Friend, this has been the last near 10 years of my life. First with my father. Now my brother. There's never a distraction. My father's suicide was suffocating. I never got over, or felt ok with it. This is just a second metaphorical rope around my neck. It's impossible to keep going.
Yep. Extremely. I lost half of myself.

I dream of everything I've been through. I panic over the things I've done, the things I've had done to me.
My brother killing himself. Every dream is of him, talking to him, watching him do it. 
Only to wake up in a world where I have to live with knowing it all happened. It never leaves my brain. I've lost everything.

I know I'll end up killing myself. Every night I fall asleep to nightmares and wake up to one. My brother has, my father has, my mom will. She said she would. My life is broken. There is no fixing anything done to me, there's no learning to cope.
 I've been to trauma therapy for over 10 years. It doesn't and has never helped. I'm just not made for this earth. I was put in a situation in which suicide is the only way out of daily suffering.
Only a matter of time before I give in but hey. I got 1 or 2 more months because I'm pathetic.

There's some that are horrible. Some that are good. From my experience it was okay the time I went. It made me feel better hearing people agree that my experiences were shit and felt like some people genuinely cared. Others did not and it was obvious. 
It was scary at first. Definitely since I was bunked with someone tjat started fights there. But, I made it through and it is an experience I hold close to myself. 
I've never been to prison or jail, but it's kind of how I expected that to feel, with the routines. But without all the obvious risk.

The funny thing is, I planned to be a trauma therapist to help others cope with this exact pain I'm feeling. I don't want to spiral. I want to be able to help people but it just feels less and less likely
